# Actor (core.Actor)

## Definition
Ein handelndes Subjekt im System (Mensch oder System).

## Typical usage
- Used as the supertype for entities that can take actions and hold responsibilities.

## Common confusions
- Confused with passive artifacts (documents, datasets).
